items.label: SOLID FRAMEWORK & PE RATTAN
items.value: Kullavik whole structure of the outdoor patio furniture set includes two main parts. One is the solid anti-rust steel frame which is made of -coated heavy-duty metal, enhancing the stability considerably. The second part is the PE rattan which is synthetic manual wicker. This kind of wick is more sturdy and durable than others, making sure the sofa set can be used for a long time

items.label: UPGRADED DESIGNS SOFA
items.value: The patio conversation sets of 2024 is totally upgraded, especially the widened armrest and the heightened back support. The widened armrest gives you more space to hold your arm, improving your user experience. Also, you also can put books or drinks on the armrest when you enjoy the outdoor life. Meanwhile, the heightened back support is more ergonomic which can enlarge the surface between you and the back support, giving you the most comfortable user experience

items.label: FREE COMBINATION
items.value: Kullavik cushion covers are made of high-density fabric which is durable and anti-splashing. Meanwhile, you can set up this patio sectional sofa set in different shapes according to your own preference. This unique characteristic makes it more usable and fashionable

items.label: PACKAGING
items.value: This outdoor sofa set comes in 3 boxes, which contain different accessories and instructions, you need to spend some time to assemble them

items.label: Excellent Quality
items.value: The cushion is made of high-density sponge, flexible and soft for added comfort. The cushions are zipped for easy removal and cleaning. All cushions have a Velcro anti-slip design so that the cushions do not slip off easily. Our patio sofa sets offer great comfort.

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Wipe to Lock, Wipe with Damp Cloth

items.label: Assembly Instructions Description
items.value: Assemble by following instructions provided in the 3 boxes.
